delegation_proof.description: SPEC 5.2. Records that the on_behalf_of chain was proved by an RFC 8693 token, without carrying the token: a delegation token is a live credential and an event stream is a replicated, hash-chained record. Absent means NOT proven, never proven elsewhere.

jti.description: The token's id, so an auditor can find it in the issuer's own record.

jkt.description: RFC 7638 thumbprint the token was bound to: who was holding it, which a chain of names cannot say.

iss.description: The issuer, so the right keys and the right revocation list are consulted.

exp.description: When the proof stopped being one. SPEC 2 says the chain carries no freshness; this is the freshness, and it belongs to the proof.
